confidence_notes: Food and coffee estimates are supported by local price ranges and a January 2026 cost-of-living snapshot with only nine contributors and wide ranges. Alcohol service is scarce or restricted; beer follows the local crowd-sourced draft price, while cocktail and wine prices are inferred at about 2.5 and 3 times beer. Accommodation is a holistic estimate, not based on live listings.
comparable_city_reasoning: No single comparable city; food and cafe anchors use Rishikesh-specific local price observations, while accommodation reflects its low-cost pilgrimage and backpacker-town profile.
